providers.simple.1: Nothing to set up. Your voice goes to Gemini and comes back as speech over one connection, with the transcript and every tool call on the same wire.
providers.simple.2: Pick MY OWN SETUP above to run it on your own machine, or through another company's model.
providers.background.desc: Reading a document, looking at your screen, writing code — the assistant's own requests, not the conversation. These use Gemini's text quota, which runs out before the voice does. Sending them somewhere else keeps them working, and changes nothing you hear.
providers.coding.desc: The model that plans, writes and fixes projects when you ask the assistant to build something. Saved to Desktop/JarvisProjects.
providers.uses_thinking: Uses the model you chose for ② THINKING.
providers.quota_warning: Left as it is, these keep using Gemini and stop working when its text quota runs out.
providers.coding.inherits: Code is written by whatever answers background requests above.
providers.coding.same_as_background: Uses the settings under BACKGROUND REQUESTS.
